title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 28th July 2026 | TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Excellent number once the UAE provision is added back; weak today on a cyber attack but a good bet at lower levels.
recommendations.detail: In his market view Kutumba Rao noted that FII exposure is being increased in PSU banks and reduced in private banks, and that public sector bank NPAs and net interest income are decent. He said that in a bank like Bank of Baroda, even though their biggest provision was made in the UAE, if you look at it adding back that provision amount it is an excellent number. Bank of Baroda may be weak today because there was a cyber attack, but at lower levels it can become a good bet.

recommendations.note: Looks extremely good near its 52-week high, but the good entry price is 680-700 and such a correction may not come immediately.
recommendations.detail: A caller asked for entry prices on Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances and Ratnaveer Precision, and the anchor put the question to Kutumba Rao first. He said there was a corporate action in between that must be looked at carefully, because the integrated takeover and all of that has been completed. As of now the stock is looking extremely good and is quite close to its 52-week highs, but if you ask about the entry price, between 680 and 700 is a good entry price. The stock is already at 780, so whether that much of a correction will come immediately he could not say.

recommendations.note: Result-wise the stock looks extremely strong; any decline can be used, with scope to 275-280.
recommendations.detail: Kutumba Rao said Ratnaveer Precision, along with the other precision engineering companies, saw activity increase and the stock jumped, and it also gave a decent result - after the result the other day activity increased quite a bit and the stock reached its 52-week high. He said any decline can be used, because although one cannot say how much management quality there is, result-wise the stock looks extremely strong, and maybe there is even scope for it to go up to 275-280 (as heard). He added that over the last several quarters Ratnaveer has been announcing good numbers.

recommendations.price: target revised up to 2600-2800 within 12 months (stock at 1720)
recommendations.note: Hold the winning horse - 2000-plus comes easily and the target is revised to 2600-2800 within 12 months; don't switch to RR Kabel.
recommendations.detail: Caller Madan bought Laurus Labs at 285 and 200 shares at 310 and wanted to sell and buy RR Kabel. Kutumba Rao said Laurus will get to 2,000-plus easily and that he is revising the target to 2,600-2,800 within 12 months, with nobody able to stop it unless the Nifty falls some 5,000 points; it will keep rising in higher-top, higher-bottom fashion, though one should not expect Rs 100-200 every month just because a big target was given. The positives are the jump in the CDMO share of revenue, the company having entered other specialities early, returns on the capex already spent and returns from the AP unit over the next two years. His verdict: hold on to Laurus, because holding on by catching hold of the winning horse is very key. On the switch he added that RR Kabel too has announced good results consecutively over the last several quarters, but they are two different industries, and as long as a company keeps announcing good results, leaving it is not a good thing.

recommendations.price: caller bought 800 shares at 241 for trading
recommendations.note: On-and-off liquidity problem; not a very great stock for positional trading and not a stock to trade at all.
recommendations.detail: Caller Krishnakumari bought 800 shares at Rs 241 for trading and asked whether to hold and where to place a stop-loss. Kutumba Rao said that in stocks like Walchandnagar there is also a liquidity problem, on and off: on some news - such as the idea that it is going into nuclear power - it suddenly trades in lakhs and then immediately falls back into thousands. It is not a very great stock for positional trading; the stock had already gone to 300-plus and has now come down, and on the small nuclear reactors only Hindalco is the single bidder. He concluded that leaving aside the rest, the fundamentals and factors, it is not a stock to trade. (Ramakrishna separately gave the technical stop-loss of 224-223.)

recommendations.note: Up-move appears to have started; wait and the 25% loss may be recovered in another three or four months.
recommendations.detail: Caller Sravani bought KFin Technologies at 1,200 and is at a 25% loss. The answer was that action began in this counter only yesterday and that this looks to have started its up-move; if she waits, her price will come, and there appears to be a chance of the 25% loss coming back within another three or four months. The captions carry no speaker label on this answer, but Kutumba Rao had cited KFin performing well in his own market view moments earlier, and the anchor then turned separately to Kranthi for his view - Kranthi's own hold-and-book-profit-on-rallies answer is recorded in kranti.json.

recommendations.price: keep a stop around 65-66; target three figures / 100
recommendations.note: One of the few smaller banks showing this much strength, at its 52-week high with an extremely good result; all set for three figures.
recommendations.detail: Caller Ramakrishna from Hyderabad is in 90% profit and asked whether to hold or book profit. Kutumba Rao said Ujjivan is showing very good strength and there is no doubt about that; it is one of the few smaller banks among the stocks showing this much strength and it is at its 52-week high. Even now, if you ask him, it is a trading stock - keeping a stop around 65-66, he says hold the stock, as it looks all set for a three-figure price and the possibility of touching 100 is clearly visible. The result too was extremely good, so: hold.

recommendations.price: caller holding at 510; no fresh buying at these levels
recommendations.note: An effective B-group counter - book partial profit and stay, but he would not suggest buying at these levels.
recommendations.detail: Caller Naresh Kumar holds POCL at Rs 510 (the anchor confirmed POCL means Pondy Oxides) and asked whether to hold or exit. Kutumba Rao said both this and Siemens Energy are effective counters in the B group, but definitely, if you ask him, he would say book partial profit and then stay. As for buying, he would not suggest it at these levels.

recommendations.price: caller holding at 3400; stabilising near 3200 after almost 4000
recommendations.note: Highly speculative move to almost 4000 and now stabilising near 3200; book partial profit and decide after the results.
recommendations.detail: The same caller holds Siemens Energy (as heard) at Rs 3,400. Kutumba Rao's blanket advice for both his counters was to book partial profit and stay, and not to buy at these levels, because with high speculation the stock went to almost 4,000 and is now stabilising near 3,200. He added that the results are already expected, so maybe the caller can take a decision after the results.

recommendations.price: stop-loss 420; below 420 it can fall to 300
recommendations.note: Weak, a weak wicket forming lower top lower bottom; this result is key, else keep a 420 stop-loss.
recommendations.detail: Caller Lakshmanachari asked whether Kilburn Engineering can be entered or bought here. Kutumba Rao said it is weak: last quarter was slightly disappointing, and although it seems ordinary-to-better numbers-wise, looking at everything it was definitely a weak wicket, which is why it continuously formed a lower top and lower bottom. This time the result is key - if a turnaround doesn't come in this result, he would say keep a 420 stop-loss on the stock, and below 420 it can go down to even 300.
